jessica_sales: Hey team — FinLedger wants a final, auditable POC deprovision plan before sign-off. They specifically asked: hosted API key invalidation, dedicated pool teardown, VPC cleanup, and confirmation on data retention/wiping. Any required steps or blockers? @sam_engineering @andrew_ps

sam_engineering: For hosted keys we can either revoke via Console (Org > API keys > Revoke) or call the admin API. Quick example to revoke a key: ```bash
curl -X POST
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/keys/revoke
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"key_id":"fk_live_XXXX"}'
```
Note: revocation is immediate; any in-flight requests tied to that key will 401. We should advise the customer to rotate any stored secrets in their app.

andrew_ps: Dedicated pool teardown checklist (short):
- mark pool as draining: `redwood pool update --id <pool-id> --drain true`
- wait for inflight inference to finish (monitor `pool.metrics.inflight`)
- set autoscale min=0 and disable bursts
- deallocate GPUs / delete instances via console or `redwood pool destroy --id <pool-id>`
- explicitly wipe KV cache and local model cache: `redwood pool wipe-cache --id <pool-id> --mode full`
We also need to delete any customer-managed volumes (NFS/EBS) attached during the POC. That deletion is irreversible — call out in ticket.

nora_ops: VPC/private cleanup notes: remove VPC peering, delete route entries, and teardown Transit Gateway attachments if used. Also: revoke IAM role permissions used for the POC and rotate any service-account credentials. For audit, we produce a CSV of all ENIs and SGs removed.

nora_ops: Data retention / deletion policy to confirm with customer: by default we retain telemetry and logs for 30 days, and request/response payloads for POCs are configurable but set to 30 days and can be shortened on request. For Dedicated/Private with on-prem storage, customer data sits behind their KMS and we only mark pointers for deletion — ops must run `data-purge --scope poc-<id> --confirm` to remove persisted payloads. We need explicit customer sign-off for >30 day retention.

sam_engineering: A couple security items:
- If they used SSO SAML, we should remove SSO mapping for the POC group and rotate any linked API tokens.
- If they requested archived logs for the engagement, generate HMAC-signed export and store in their S3; confirm lifecycle policy.

deploy-bot: scheduled-teardown-runbook started for poc-1767 — step 1/6: snapshot metrics and export audit CSV.

jessica_sales: Sounds good — I'll create a support ticket with the teardown checklist and request the customer's written approval for data purge. I'll schedule a 30-min window next Wed for the ops run.

andrew_ps: I'll prepare the exact `redwood` CLI commands and an ops playbook snippet for the ticket.

jessica_sales: Thanks. No blockers called out here; once I have customer's signed approval we'll run and close the POC. :thumbsup:
